standard_prerequisites.name: Sheaf-level characterization
standard_prerequisites.use: the full equivalence construction for cartesian sheaves of sets and abelian groups, transplanted to modules.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 2642-2659): in Situation situation-simplicial-site, the category of cartesian O-modules on C_total is equivalent to the category of pairs (F, alpha) where F is an O_0-module and alpha: (f_{delta_1^1})^*F -> (f_{delta_0^1})^*F is an isomorphism of O_1-modules satisfying (f_{delta^2_1})^*alpha = (f_{delta^2_0})^*alpha composed with (f_{delta^2_2})^*alpha as O_2-module maps.

Proof (lines 2661-2666): identical to Lemma lemma-characterize-cartesian with pullback of sheaves of abelian groups replaced by pullback of modules - the functor construction, the quasi-inverse via the tau degeneracies, and the verification go through verbatim because every map used is a module map under the ring pullback.
proof_roadmap: Transport the sheaf-level equivalence construction to modules.
Replace inverse images by module pullbacks along the face maps.
Keep the cocycle condition and the quasi-inverse verbatim.
difficulty_reason: Equivalence lemma (statement 2642-2659, proof 2661-2666): module version of the cartesian-descent-data characterization - the proof is an explicit single-substitution transport ('identical ... with pullback of sheaves of abelian groups replaced by pullback of modules') of the fully constructive sheaf-level proof delivered as a sibling card in this batch; the substituted objects (module pullbacks along the face maps) are named in-span. H3.
